reviews.t: Great for nail art!
reviews.x: I use this as a nail art barrier and it works just as well or even better than the nail specific brands. I use a small funnel or syringe to transfer it to an old cleaned out nail polish bottle. It is also far more cost effective. You get 4 oz. for the same price that you pay for half an oz. Of the nail specific brands. It came in a timely manner and was properly packaged.

reviews.t: Great for nail stamping!
reviews.x: Nail stamping is my new fun thing to do.  It can be a bit messy.  Latex sold for stamping and the non-latex type don't cover as well and I need to use several coats, which means I spend more to get less product.  This stuff goes on nice and thick and dries relatively quickly, which means I have less cleanup.  This also peels off much easier than the nail stamping latex.  Can't think of any negative thing to say about it.

reviews.t: I'm comfortable putting this stuff on my face
reviews.x: There is some smell, but it's tolerable. I'm comfortable putting this stuff on my face, while the non-ammonia-free stuff I have is intolerable to my nose and eyes.  The use of this kind of wide lid plastic container is a little odd (the other brand I had uses a narrow cap). After pouring a little latex inevitably ends up in the threads. And even if you clean it up, some inevitably solidifies and some strings need to be pulled off the next time you open it.

reviews.t: Used for Skin around Nails
reviews.x: I actually bought this liquid latex to use around my nails in order to prevent the nail polish from going on my skin and found it very efficient. It's very easy to apply as well as very easily removable by just tugging on one part of the paint and it peeling off altogether once you pull on it gently.

reviews.t: Hard to cover up with makeup
reviews.x: It worked well to "glue" the zipper to my face (Halloween costume) but the latex was very visible, and did not cover up/blend well with liquid foundation.

claims.text: Works excellently for nail art and manicure cleanup, often performing as well as or better than nail-specific brands.
The smell is noticeable but generally milder than regular latex, though some reviewers dispute the ammonia-free claim.
Dries quickly and goes on thick, making it convenient for masking and protection tasks.
Good value and cost-effective compared to smaller nail-specific latex bottles.
Some reviewers received the wrong color or item, requiring returns.
